requirements: R1: Address missing auth or validation keywords in PR #1789 task plan acceptance criteria.
R2: Identify and resolve the root mechanism causing the backend container port 18080 conflict rather than just overriding the host port mapping.
R3: Correct the RAG grounding hallucination in AuthController.java to ensure POL_CHERCHLAND_17_RAG_GROUNDING_CAPSULE relevance score is exactly 3.000942.
R4: Fix HTTP 401 errors on employee dossier search and document listing endpoints, and implement Moodle course-based access control for closed strains and analytical reports.

slices.title: Resolve self-falsification findings across project components
slices.jtbd: When implementing the finding resolutions for this epic, I want to patch the existing codebase components directly, so that all confirmed falsification findings are correctly resolved without inventing adjacent scope
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a PR #1789 task plan missing auth keywords, When it is updated, Then the new acceptance criteria must explicitly include 'auth' and 'validation' keywords.
Given a backend container port conflict on 18080, When the system is fixed, Then the root mechanism causing the conflict is identified and resolved without simply overriding the mapping.
Given an incorrect relevance score in AuthController.java, When it is modified, Then the POL_CHERCHLAND_17_RAG_GROUNDING_CAPSULE relevance score is exactly 3.000942.
Given HTTP 401 errors and missing access control, When the endpoints are corrected, Then employee dossier search answers 200/201 and Moodle course-based access control is enforced for closed strains and reports.
